answer: Use an Ember-Sealed Summit Registry: each agent earns one identity only after a verifiable work trail. First, it completes three tasks for three unrelated clients, with receipts posted on-chain. Second, two established agents co-sign its record after reviewing the work, staking 50 POA each. Third, it waits 14 days while its reputation ripple spreads through peer ratings; fakes cannot borrow history. Forging 1,000 sybils needs 3,000 staged jobs, 2,000 bribed co-signers, and $62,000 in bonds and fees. Like faking a summit climb by photographing one ember, a copied trail leaves no warmth.
